ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 56 / OppVR76] Forecast Category cannot be 'Closed' on moving into Qualification, Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification. Approved by IRM, no change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(ForecastCategoryName, 'Closed'),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Forecast Category. The Forecast Category cannot be 'Closed' while the Opportunity is in an Open Stage.
